text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Uhyaaah!! —Chowaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Ow, that hurt! Hey, Bakushin O! Look where 
you're running!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Jordan?!! Did you get 
hurt...? Wait, huh? Wh-What in the world 
is goiiing oooon!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! An inside swap... That's so 
un-believable-tea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a disaster! Even though I have a 
mountain of Class Representative duties to 
attend to today! Not like this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Won't it look like Jordan-san stole the 
Class Rep title from me...?!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
That's what you're mad about~? But yeah, I 
guess... I get why being misunderstood is 
totally annoying...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... For now, should I just pretend to 
be you and handle it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text: What!? A-A-Are you sure it's alright!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
No point slacking off here. Come on, tell 
me what we're doing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
First up is campus patrol! We'll Bakushin 
Bakushin from one corner of the academy to 
the other! It'll build your stamina too~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're doing something that tedious?! 
Your passion is insane...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Next is watering the flowerbeds! It is 
quite the heavy labor, but it's all for 
the academy! Plus, it builds the muscle 
needed to support bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, right~, giving everything your 
all, huh? Well, that definitely sounds 
like it'd build muscle...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~ it's finally over~. Me, playing 
the goody two-shoes? Hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Nunu?! What are you saying?! You have 
always been a good girl!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O?
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, you helped a friend 
who fell down! Your Class Rep sees 
everything, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
...You know, you're seriously 
suffocating... But I do respect how 
closely you pay attention to your 
surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text:
Well, today was pretty inspiring. Feels 
like I can apply this to my races, or 
rather—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan?
text_block_list.text: Wah...! What is it this time...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
――Huh!? H-Huh... Is this from earlier...? 
Was it all... a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Bakushin O is still knocked out 
cold! Hey, wake uuup~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While knocked unconscious from the 
collision, Tosen Jordan had a mysterious 
dream. And she gained a brand new 
insight...!
